source.stem:
The diameter of a copper wire is thought to be approximately 0.3 mm.
Which instrument should be used to obtain a more accurate measurement of the diameter of the wire?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: A plastic paper clip moves toward the magnet through glass.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Any sheet, including a thick steel sheet, leaves the compass deflection unchanged.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Cardboard stops the compass deflection, but clear glass does not.

intelligence.enrichment: A magnet can move some objects without touching them. Sheets of wood, cardboard, plastic, or glass placed between a magnet and a compass needle do not cause any appreciable change in the needle's deflection. a magnetic effect can act across a gap and through listed non-magnetic sheets The learner predicts that wood, cardboard, thin plastic, and glass do not stop the magnetic effect on a compass needle or steel object in the described tests. A magnet works only when it touches the object, and any sheet in between blocks the pull.
